notes.title: Dreamwalker Leaves Early Access - The Journey Begins
notes.notes: [h1]Dreamwalker Has Officially Launched - Now 30% Off![/h1][p]We’re incredibly excited to announce that [b]Dreamwalker is out of Early Access and fully released[/b], with a [b]launch discount of 30%[/b] for a limited time![/p][p][/p][p]This marks the culmination of over a year of hard work by a tiny team of two people - building a surreal dreamlike world while juggling full-time jobs and our first experience making a game. What started as a small idea has grown into something bigger than we imagined, thanks in no small part to all of you who joined us early and helped shape what Dreamwalker is today.[/p][h2][/h2][p][/p][h2]What’s New in Version 1.0?[/h2][list][*][p][b]Refined card-based combat[/b] -improved balance and gameplay[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded merchant system[/b] - more shops, items, and trade options[/p][/*][*][p][b]Broader card collection[/b] - new strategies and combinations[/p][/*][*][p][b]More NPCs[/b] - a more dynamic and reactive world[/p][/*][*][p][b]New dreams to uncover[/b] - deeper story and hidden rewards[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam achievements[/b] - unlockable milestones and secrets[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved environmental detail and atmosphere[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]8 languages supported[/b] - English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Russian[/p][p][/p][p][b]Note:[/b] If you played during Early Access, we recommend starting a new save to fully experience all the new content, story improvements, and system changes.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New to Dreamwalker?[/h3][p][b]Dreamwalker[/b] is a narrative exploration game with light card-based combat, set inside a surreal dream world.[/p][p]You’ll explore shifting realities, uncover lost memories, and solve puzzles in a strange and emotional journey.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for dreaming with us.[/p][p][/p][p]If you enjoy the game, please consider [b]leaving a review or telling a friend[/b] - it helps a small team like ours more than you know.[/p][p][/p][p]- The Dreamwalker Devs [/p]

notes.title: Dreamwalker Now Available!
notes.notes:
At long last, the veil between worlds has parted. What began as whispers in the dark has materialized into reality. We're thrilled to announce that Dreamwalker has officially emerged from the shadows and is now available!

Like a dreamer finally breaking through to consciousness, our creation has overcome the final barriers of the publishing realm. The mysterious pathways have cleared, allowing you to step into the world we've crafted with such care.

Every crystal cavern, every whispered secret, every puzzle awaiting your touch — it's all there, waiting for you to discover. The footprints you've been eager to follow now lead somewhere real.

We want to express our deepest gratitude for your patience during our brief delay. Your understanding illuminated our path forward like lanterns in the mist.

Step through the threshold. Explore. Dream. Discover.

The journey begins now.

Smiling Sloth

notes.title: Release On Hold Due to Steam Technical Issue
notes.notes:
We regret to inform you that our planned release has been temporarily delayed due to an unexpected technical issue with Steam's publishing system. Our game is ready to go, but we're currently experiencing obstacles in the final publishing steps.

We are actively working with Steam support to resolve this as quickly as possible. We understand this is disappointing — we're disappointed too, as we've been counting down the minutes to share our work with you. We appreciate your patience and support during this unexpected hurdle.

Thank you for your understanding,
Smiling Sloth

notes.title: The Dream Becomes Real on May 5th
notes.notes:
Hello Dreamwalkers,

We have some exciting news to share with you today - our game finally has an official release date: [b]May 5th, 2025![/b]

After more than a year of development, countless late nights, playtesting, and refining our vision, we're thrilled (and a little nervous) to put this date on the calendar. As our very first game, this milestone means the world to our small team of two.

Over the coming weeks, we'll be polishing gameplay mechanics, squashing bugs, and adding final touches to make sure the game meets the quality standards you deserve. For those who participated in our playtests - your feedback has been invaluable, and we've implemented many of your suggestions.

In the meantime, if you haven’t already, wishlist the game to be notified the moment it goes live.

Thank you for being with us on this journey. As always, we welcome your comments, questions, and excitement!

With gratitude,
Smiling Sloth

Until then... sweet dreams.

notes.title: Playtest is live!
notes.notes:
Hello Dreamwalkers,

Our second round of playtesting is now live!

If you had access during the first round, you should be able to install the game and start playing. However, if you participated in the first test, please delete your old save file, as it will not be compatible with this version.

Keep in mind that this is not the final version—there’s still a lot of work to be done! If you encounter any bugs, please let us know. We’d also love to hear your thoughts and feedback.

Happy testing, and thank you for your support!

notes.title: Our first post!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello, Dreamwalkers![/b]

First off, thank you to everyone who has wishlisted our game. Your support is what keeps us motivated as we work to bring our vision to life. We know we haven’t shared any updates here on Steam yet, so we’re taking this opportunity to finally share some details about the project.

[b]Who We Are[/b]

We’re a small team of two balancing full-time jobs while working on this game in our spare time. We started development in March 2024, and this is our first game. It’s been a challenging but rewarding process, and we’re excited to finally share more about it with you.

Our target release date is the end of March 2025. If we need extra time to ensure the game meets our standards, we’re prepared to aim for April 2025. Quality is our top priority.

[b]What’s Next?[/b]

We’ve held some playtests already, and another one is coming up soon. If you’ve already been granted playtest access but couldn’t participate last time, this is your chance to join in and try the game.

In February, we’ll also be attending Steam NextFest. During this event, we’ll release a demo that everyone will be able to play.

Thank you again for being part of this journey with us. We’ll be posting updates here on Steam more regularly as development progresses, so keep an eye out for news and behind-the-scenes content.

Feel free to leave a comment or reach out—we’re happy to hear from you.

Until next time,
Smiling Sloth
